title: Reinstatement Provision of Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Right.** A Whole Life Insurance policy that lapsed, or that went onto extended term or reduced paid-up insurance by default or election, may be reinstated on the owner's signed application, unless it was surrendered for cash.

**Window.** The reinstatement application must be signed no later than the default date plus the tier's reinstatement window in calendar months. The window end is found by adding the number of calendar months to the default date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; an application signed on the window end is in time. The default date is the date the policy record shows as the due date of the unpaid installment on which the policy lapsed or went onto a nonforfeiture option; the signed date is the one on the reinstatement application on file.

**Evidence.** Evidence of insurability follows the tier's evidence ladder, by calendar days from the default date to the application's signed date.

**Approval.** The policy is reinstated only on a reinstatement application whose request status is approved.

**Amount.** The reinstatement amount is every installment from the default date through the reinstatement date, plus simple interest at the tier's reinstatement interest rate on each installment from its due date, for actual days over 365, rounded to the cent per installment. Any loan that was extinguished at default is either repaid or reinstated as a loan with interest from the default date.

**Contestability.** Statements in the reinstatement application are contestable for the tier's contestable period from the reinstatement date.

## Window boundary cases (hypothetical, window of 60 months)

| Default date | Window end | Signed on | In time |
|---|---|---|---|
| August 31, 2021 | August 31, 2026 | August 31, 2026 | Yes |
| August 31, 2021 | August 31, 2026 | September 1, 2026 | No |
| February 29, 2020 | February 28, 2025 (no February 29 that year) | February 28, 2025 | Yes |

## Worked reinstatement amount (hypothetical, interest rate 6%, non-leap year)

Two installments of 300.00, due January 1 and April 1; reinstatement date July 1.

| Installment due | Days to July 1 | Interest | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| January 1 | 181 | 300.00 times 0.06 times 181, over 365: 8.93 | 308.93 |
| April 1 | 91 | 300.00 times 0.06 times 91, over 365: 4.49 | 304.49 |
| Total | | | 613.42 |
